args.task: Assess the macro regime and equity risk environment relevant to analyzing NVDA and producing a full research report. Use the macro data tools to gather current readings on monetary policy, inflation, growth, liquidity, and the yield curve. Produce the structured output specified in your backstory. Focus on the macro signal, do not discuss individual company details.
args.context: The current task is to assess the macro regime and equity risk environment. This assessment will be used as context for a full research report on NVDA. The output should be a structured macro assessment with sections: Macro Summary, Monetary Policy, Inflation & Growth, Liquidity & Credit, Yield Curve, Equity Risk Regime, and a Confidence Score (1-10).
